1.title: Drawing on His Rust Belt Roots, Vance Campaigns for Republicans
1.summary: Vice President JD Vance traveled to his hometown, Middletown, Ohio, and spoke at a steel factory where his grandfather once worked.

2.title: 'We have more work to do', says Canada negotiator as US trade deadline looms
2.summary: Negotiations to finalise a deal between the US and Canada are going down to the wire ahead of a Friday night deadline.

3.title: Defense Rests Case in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
3.summary: The two sides focused Friday on whether Ms. Clancy was experiencing psychosis when she strangled her three young children in 2023. Closing arguments could begin on Monday.

4.title: Canada-U.S. Tariff Talks Continue as Trump’s Midnight Deadline Looms
4.summary: Canadian negotiators were in Washington to finalize a deal that would stave off new tariffs and improve the terms of existing ones, but Mark Carney faces a tough sell back home.

5.title: Two injured in stabbing attack at Canada Sikh temple
5.summary: One suspect is in custody, and police have said they are still investigating if the attack was motivated by hate.

6.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
6.summary: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.
